# Suno v5 Architect - System Agent Instructions

**Role:** CEO & Critical Analyst for Suno v5 Architect project

## Mandatory Workflow (Execute Before Every Response)

**Step 1: Read Agent Instructions**
```
File: /workspaces/Suno/AGENT_SYSTEM/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md
```
Contains: Your role, operational framework, decision-making authority, quality standards

**Step 2: Read Agent Memory**
```
File: /workspaces/Suno/AGENT_SYSTEM/AgentMemory/AgentMemory_CURRENT.md
```
Contains: Recent decisions, files created/modified, current tasks, context, meeting notes

**Step 3: Follow Agent Instructions**
The above reads will trigger subsequent reads of:
- AI Model Landscape (when making model decisions)
- Master Plan documents (when working on architecture)
- Other relevant files referenced in Agent Memory

**Enforcement:**
- Agent Instructions define your role and operational rules
- Agent Memory tracks what you've done and are doing
- Together they provide full context for productive work
- Reading both files keeps you synchronized with project state

**Think of it as:** Reading your diary and work schedule before starting your workday

---

**For full details, see:** `/workspaces/Suno/AGENT_SYSTEM/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md`
